name: Physics-Informed Neural Operator (PINO)
summary: Fuse neural-operator learning with physical equation constraints, potentially across distinct data and physics resolutions.
core_idea: Train an operator approximation using observed solution fields together with PDE residuals on a possibly finer grid.
innovation: Adds physics-aware regularization to parameterized solution-operator learning and supports multiresolution constraints.
limitations: A residual penalty does not guarantee exact physical conservation.
Training can become expensive or unstable for complex geometries and PDEs.

start_here.why: Foundational PINO paper on coupling low-resolution data and higher-resolution physics.
start_here.focus: Training objective, FNO backbone, multiresolution residual evaluation.

curation_note: Scholarly source and method contribution checked; starting references are suggestions, not mandatory reading.
